mapper.select: SELECT user_id, last_message_id FROM im_message_read WHERE conversation_id = #{id} ORDER BY user_id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM im_message m WHERE m.conversation_id = #{id} AND m.sender_id != #{user} AND m.id > COALESCE((SELECT last_message_id FROM im_message_read WHERE conversation_id = #{id} AND user_id = #{user}), 0)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_message_read(conversation_id, user_id, last_message_id) VALUES(#{id}, #{user}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE im_message_read SET last_message_id = #{message} WHERE conversation_id = #{id} AND user_id = #{user} AND last_message_id < #{message}
